meta_title: Turner's Plumbing & Heating | Emergency Plumber Wolverhampton
meta_description: Turner's Independent Plumbing and Heating in Wolverhampton. Emergency repairs, boiler installations, and heating services. Fast response, fair prices. Call now.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or broken boiler in Wolverhampton? We're here same day, any time. Fair prices, no surprises.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Wolverhampton
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to full system overhauls, we handle every aspect of your plumbing and heating.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repairs
services.desc: Broken down mid-winter? We diagnose and fix most boiler faults the same day. No call-out charge if you book us on the spot.

services.title: Burst Pipe & Leak Repairs
services.desc: Water damage can escalate fast. Our team finds the source, stops the leak, and makes good the damage — usually within the hour of your call.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Upgrades
services.desc: Replacing an old unit or installing a new condensing boiler? We handle the lot: removal, pipework, testing, and your warranty paperwork. Cuts your heating bills by up to 30%.

services.title: Central Heating Overhaul
services.desc: Cold radiators, noisy pipes, or patchy warmth? We power-flush systems, bleed radiators, and upgrade pumps and controls to restore comfort.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: New suite, relocation, or modernisation — we run pipework, install taps, and connect appliances to building regs. Fully certified for Part P self-certification.

services.title: Annual Boiler Servicing
services.desc: Keep your warranty valid and your heating efficient with our yearly safety checks and cleaning. Catches small faults before they become expensive problems.

about_pullquote: I started Turner's because I hated seeing neighbours ripped off by cowboys charging premium prices for shoddy work.
about_para_1: Turner's Independent Plumbing and Heating was founded 18 years ago on the principle that honest, skilled work shouldn't come with cowboy pricing. Based in Wolverhampton, we've built a reputation for showing up on time, diagnosing problems clearly, and fixing them right the first time. Every engineer is Gas Safe Registered and carries spare parts — because we'd rather sort your emergency today than schedule you in next week.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we treat every job — whether a radiator bleed or a full boiler replacement — with the same care and attention. We've never charged a call-out fee, we give honest quotes with no hidden extras, and we're available 24/7 for emergencies. That's earned us hundreds of repeat clients across Wolverhampton and the surrounding areas.
reviews_heading: What Wolverhampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Our boiler packed in on Christmas Eve — absolute nightmare. Called Turner's on the off-chance and they were at the door within 45 minutes. Fixed it same night and wouldn't even charge us extra for the emergency callout. Massive relief. Will use them again without hesitation.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe in the bathroom that was dripping into the kitchen ceiling. Very stressful. The lads came out, found the problem straight away, fixed the leak, and cleaned up after themselves. Price was fair and upfront — no hidden charges. Really professional outfit.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: We needed a new boiler and were quoted silly money by a big chain company. Turner's came out, explained what we actually needed, and installed a reliable condensing unit for a third of the price. It's been running perfectly for six months now and our bills have definitely come down. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.
